# BR-500 Control Narrative: Section 4, pH and Dissolved Oxygen Control

**Document:** BR-500 Control Narrative / FRS, Rev A (Draft for review)
**Module ID:** BR500 (requirement prefix FR-BR500-)
**Platform:** DeltaV DCS, GMP
**Governing standards:** ANSI/ISA-88 (phase model), ANSI/ISA-5.06.01 (structure, tag list, interlock rows, sequence tables), ASD-STE100 (text).

> **Standards note:** BR-500 is a batch unit, so ISA-88 phase states govern. ISA-106 does not apply. The pH and DO control modules use the module states in 4.3. The 4.3 tables map those states to the ISA-88 phases.

## 4.1 Purpose and Boundaries

**Function:** Hold culture pH and dissolved oxygen (DO) at recipe setpoints from the start of Equilibrate to the end of Production.

**Upstream interfaces:**
- ISA-88 phase logic (Media Fill, Equilibrate, Inoculate, Production, Harvest) enables and disables this module.
- The recipe supplies SPL-501, SPL-502, and SPL-520 as defaults.

**Downstream interfaces:**
- Batch record and audit trail (setpoint changes, base total, alarms).
- SIC-530 agitator speed loop. The DO module writes a remote setpoint only. The agitator drive logic stays in the agitation section.

**Out of scope:**
- Vessel and bag pressure protection, temperature control, feeds, and foam control.
- Vessel pressure protection overrides gas flows. It is specified in the BR-500 pressure section. See open item OI-05.
- No SIS function is assigned to this module. If the bag overpressure function becomes SIL-rated, the IEC 61511 SRS will contain it (OI-05).

## 4.3 States and Transitions

### 4.3.1 Phase-to-module map

| ISA-88 phase | AIC-501 (pH) | AIC-502 (DO) | FQI-521 base total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Media Fill | INACTIVE | INACTIVE | Reset at phase start (SEQ-501), then counts |
| Equilibrate | Enabled by SEQ-502, then AUTO | Enabled by SEQ-502, then AUTO | Counts |
| Inoculate | Continues in current state | Continues in current state | Counts |
| Production | Continues. SP changes need a reason (FR-BR500-040) | Continues. SP changes need a reason | Counts |
| Harvest | Disabled by SEQ-503, then INACTIVE | Disabled by SEQ-503, then INACTIVE | Frozen. Value written to batch record |

**Phase HOLD, STOP, and ABORT (proposed, confirm with Process, OI-03):**
- Cells stay alive during a phase hold, so pH and DO control continue.
- If any phase from Equilibrate to Production goes to HELD, the loops stay in their current state.
- If the phase goes to STOPPED or ABORTED, the loops stay in their current state. The system prompts the operator to confirm SEQ-503.

### 4.3.2 Control module states (AIC-501 and AIC-502 use the same model)

| State | Outputs | Entry permissives | Allowed exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| INACTIVE | All final elements at the 4.8.4 fail positions. SIC-530 released to the agitation section. | Phase is Media Fill or Harvest, or SEQ-503 complete, or cold restart | AUTO through SEQ-502 only | Phase logic | Automatic |
| AUTO | Controller drives final elements from the selected PV | At least one healthy probe. Phase is Equilibrate, Inoculate, or Production. For AIC-501 base side: FQI-521 below SPL-514 and WT-521 healthy. | MANUAL, PV-FAIL HOLD, INACTIVE | Operator (MANUAL), auto (PV-FAIL HOLD), phase (INACTIVE) | Automatic |
| MANUAL | Operator sets controller output %. Split-range and interlocks still apply. | Phase is Equilibrate, Inoculate, or Production | AUTO, INACTIVE | Operator (AUTO), phase (INACTIVE) | Manual |
| PV-FAIL HOLD | Outputs per 4.8.1 | Both probes of that loop unhealthy | MANUAL (operator) | Auto entry, operator exit | Operator-prompted |

**Base-side lockout (AIC-501 substate, applies in AUTO and MANUAL):**
- P-520 is stopped. CO2 control continues.
- Entry: interlock rows I-501 or I-502 in 4.6.
- Exit: per the reset method in 4.6.

### 4.3.3 Requirements, states

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-001 | AIC-501 and AIC-502 are INACTIVE in Media Fill and Harvest. | Run each phase in simulation. Try to put each loop in AUTO and MANUAL. Verify rejection and fail-position outputs. |
| FR-BR500-002 | AIC-501 and AIC-502 enter AUTO only through SEQ-502. | From INACTIVE, try a direct mode change to AUTO. Verify rejection. Run SEQ-502. Verify AUTO. |
| FR-BR500-003 | In a phase HELD state, AIC-501 and AIC-502 keep their current state and outputs. | Hold Production with both loops in AUTO. Disturb the PV. Verify that the loops still respond. |
| FR-BR500-004 | On phase STOP or ABORT, the loops keep their current state and the system prompts for SEQ-503. | Abort Production. Verify the loops stay in AUTO and the prompt appears. Confirm. Verify INACTIVE. |
| FR-BR500-005 | On a phase change from Production to Harvest, the system runs SEQ-503 automatically. | Complete Production. Verify SEQ-503 runs and both loops end in INACTIVE. |

## 4.4 Regulatory Control

### 4.4.1 Probe selection and health (AY-501 and AY-502)

A probe is **healthy** when all of these conditions are true:
- Signal status is good.
- PV is inside the valid range (SPL-505/506 for pH, SPL-523 for DO).
- The operator has not put the probe out of service.

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-010 | When both probes are healthy and the operator selects AVERAGE, the selected PV is the arithmetic mean of probes A and B. | Inject two different healthy values. Verify AY-501 and AY-502 show the mean. |
| FR-BR500-011 | When one probe is unhealthy, the selected PV changes to the healthy probe without a bump in the controller output. | Fail AT-501A (bad status, then out of range). Verify AY-501 equals AT-501B and the output has no step. Repeat for B, and for AT-502A/B. |
| FR-BR500-012 | When a failed probe becomes healthy again, the system does not add it back automatically. The operator must select AVERAGE. | Restore AT-501A. Verify AY-501 stays on B until the operator selects AVERAGE. |
| FR-BR500-013 | The operator can select AVERAGE, A only, or B only. The selected source shows on the faceplate. | Select each option. Verify the PV source and the display. |
| FR-BR500-014 | If the absolute difference between probes A and B is above the deviation limit for longer than the delay, the system alarms. Control continues on the selected PV. | Set pH probes apart by more than SPL-507 for longer than SPL-508. Verify alarm and no mode change. Repeat for DO with SPL-524 and SPL-525. |

### 4.4.2 pH control, AIC-501

- **PV:** AY-501.
- **SP:** recipe default SPL-501. Operator entry limits are SPL-503 and SPL-504.
- **Action:** direct. A pH above the setpoint increases the output.
- **Output split at SPL-511:**
  - Output below the split point runs P-520. The pump rate increases as the output decreases, up to the maximum in SPL-513.
  - Output above the split point opens FCV-510 across the range in SPL-512.
  - At the split point, CO2 flow is at its minimum and P-520 is stopped.
- **Deadband:** the band is SPL-501 ± SPL-502.

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-020 | When AY-501 is inside the deadband, P-520 is stopped and FCV-510 holds its last output. | Hold AY-501 inside the band. Verify P-520 is stopped and the FCV-510 SP does not change for 5 min. |
| FR-BR500-021 | When AY-501 is above the band, AIC-501 increases the FCV-510 flow. P-520 stays stopped. | Step AY-501 above the band. Verify the FCV-510 SP rises and P-520 is stopped. |
| FR-BR500-022 | When AY-501 is below the band, AIC-501 decreases FCV-510 to its minimum before it starts P-520. | Step AY-501 below the band with CO2 flowing. Verify CO2 reaches minimum first, then P-520 starts. |
| FR-BR500-023 | The FCV-510 setpoint never goes outside SPL-512. The P-520 rate never goes above SPL-513. | In MANUAL, drive the output to 0 % and 100 %. Verify the limits. |
| FR-BR500-024 | AIC-501 does not start P-520 while the base-side lockout is active. | Activate I-501. Drive AY-501 below the band. Verify P-520 stays stopped and CO2 control continues. |
| FR-BR500-025 | Mode changes between AUTO and MANUAL are bumpless. | Change the mode in both directions at steady state. Verify no output step. |

### 4.4.3 Base totalizer, FQI-521

- FQI-521 counts liters of base added. It converts each decrease in WT-521 with SPL-516.
- An increase in WT-521 (bag change, bag handling) does not reduce the total.

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-030 | FQI-521 increases by each decrease in WT-521 divided by SPL-516. | Simulate a known decrease in WT-521. Verify the FQI-521 increase within SPL-540. |
| FR-BR500-031 | An increase in WT-521 does not change FQI-521. | Simulate an increase in WT-521. Verify FQI-521 does not change. |
| FR-BR500-032 | FQI-521 counts a decrease while P-520 is stopped. It also alarms if that decrease is above SPL-517. | Stop P-520. Decrease WT-521 by more than SPL-517. Verify the total increases and the alarm occurs. |
| FR-BR500-033 | FQI-521 keeps its value through controller restart and power loss. | Record FQI-521. Do a cold restart. Verify the same value. |
| FR-BR500-034 | Only SEQ-501 at the start of Media Fill resets FQI-521. | Try a reset from the faceplate in each phase. Verify rejection. Run SEQ-501. Verify zero. |
| FR-BR500-035 | At the end of Production, the system writes the FQI-521 value to the batch record. | Complete Production. Verify the batch record entry. |

### 4.4.4 DO control, AIC-502 (three-stage cascade)

- **PV:** AY-502.
- **SP:** recipe default SPL-520. Operator entry limits are SPL-521 and SPL-522.
- **Action:** reverse. A DO below the setpoint increases the output.
- **Output stages** (the split points are SPL-532 and SPL-533):

| AIC-502 output | SIC-530 remote SP | FCV-511 air | FCV-512 O2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 % to split point 1 | Minimum to maximum of SPL-529 | Minimum of SPL-530 | Minimum of SPL-531 |
| Split point 1 to split point 2 | Maximum of SPL-529 | Minimum to maximum of SPL-530 | Minimum of SPL-531 |
| Split point 2 to 100 % | Maximum of SPL-529 | Maximum of SPL-530 | Minimum to maximum of SPL-531 |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-040 | AIC-502 output drives the three stages in the order and ranges given in the 4.4.4 stage table. | In MANUAL, step the output through 0 %, each split point, and 100 %. Verify each element value. |
| FR-BR500-041 | While AIC-502 is AUTO or MANUAL, the SIC-530 setpoint is never below the SPL-529 minimum. | Drive the AIC-502 output to 0 %. Verify SIC-530 SP equals the SPL-529 minimum. |
| FR-BR500-042 | In AUTO, a DO decrease below the SP increases the stages in order. A DO increase above the SP decreases them in reverse order. | Ramp AY-502 down, then up. Verify the stage order. |
| FR-BR500-043 | The operator can take SIC-530, FCV-511, or FCV-512 out of cascade. The other stages continue under AIC-502. | Put FCV-511 in MANUAL. Verify AIC-502 still drives SIC-530 and FCV-512. Verify the audit trail entry. |
| FR-BR500-044 | If a stage does not follow its setpoint, AIC-502 continues and the next stage responds as the output increases. | Hold SIC-530 at minimum speed. Lower AY-502. Verify the output increases into the air stage, and the SIC-530 deviation alarm occurs. |

## 4.5 Sequences

### SEQ-501 Base totalizer reset (start of Media Fill)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Make sure that P-520 is stopped. | P-520 run feedback is off. | SPL-538 | Phase holds. Alarm "P-520 not stopped". |
| 2 | Prompt: "INSTALL NEW BASE BAG. CONFIRM WT-521 IS STABLE." | Operator confirms. WT-521 is healthy. | SPL-539 | Phase holds. Prompt stays. |
| 3 | Reset FQI-521 to zero. Record user, time, and WT-521 reference weight in the batch record. | FQI-521 equals zero. | SPL-538 | Phase holds. Alarm "FQI-521 reset failed". |

### SEQ-502 Enable pH and DO control (start of Equilibrate)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check probe health. | At least one healthy probe for AY-501, and at least one for AY-502. | SPL-538 | Phase holds. Prompt the operator to check the probes. |
| 2 | Check the base side. | WT-521 is healthy and FQI-521 is below SPL-514. | SPL-538 | Continue. Set the base-side lockout. Alarm. |
| 3 | Load recipe SPs (SPL-501, SPL-502, SPL-520) into AIC-501 and AIC-502. | Loaded values equal the recipe values. | SPL-538 | Phase holds. Alarm "Recipe SP load failed". |
| 4 | Put SIC-530, FCV-510, FCV-511, and FCV-512 in cascade. | All four report cascade mode. | SPL-538 | Phase holds. Alarm names the element that failed. |
| 5 | Put AIC-501 and AIC-502 in AUTO. | Both loops report AUTO. | SPL-538 | Phase holds. Loops stay in MANUAL at minimum output. |
| 6 | Record the enable event in the batch record. | Record written. | SPL-538 | Alarm. Phase continues. |

### SEQ-503 Disable pH and DO control (Harvest, or operator-confirmed after STOP/ABORT)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stop P-520. | P-520 run feedback is off. | SPL-538 | Alarm "P-520 not stopped". Prompt the operator to stop it at the local panel. |
| 2 | Set FCV-510, FCV-511, and FCV-512 to zero flow. | Each flow PV is at the SPL-512/530/531 minimum, within SPL-534. | SPL-538 | Alarm names the MFC. Prompt the operator to isolate the gas supply. |
| 3 | Release SIC-530 to the agitation section. Hold the speed at its last value. | SIC-530 is out of cascade. | SPL-538 | Alarm. Agitator holds its last speed. |
| 4 | Put AIC-501 and AIC-502 in INACTIVE. Write FQI-521 to the batch record. | Both loops are INACTIVE. Record written. | SPL-538 | Phase holds. Alarm. |

### SEQ-504 Base bag change (operator-initiated, any phase from Equilibrate to Production)

> **CAUTION:** Start SEQ-504 before you touch the base bag. If you do not, bag handling can cause a false leak alarm.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Set the base-side lockout. Stop P-520. | P-520 run feedback is off. | SPL-538 | Abort SEQ-504. Alarm. |
| 2 | Suspend the leak alarm (FR-BR500-032). FQI-521 continues to count decreases only. | Leak alarm is suspended. | SPL-538 | Abort SEQ-504. Alarm. |
| 3 | Prompt: "REPLACE BASE BAG. CONFIRM WHEN CONNECTED AND WT-521 IS STABLE." | Operator confirms. WT-521 is healthy. | SPL-519 | Alarm "Bag change overdue". Keep the lockout. Prompt stays. |
| 4 | Record the new WT-521 reference weight. Enable the leak alarm. Clear the base-side lockout if FQI-521 is below SPL-514. | Lockout clear, or I-501 still active. | SPL-538 | Lockout stays. Alarm. |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-050 | Each SEQ-501 to SEQ-504 step runs in the order shown. | Run each sequence. Verify the step order in the event journal. |
| FR-BR500-051 | Each step that does not meet its transition before the timeout does its failure response. | For each step, block the transition condition. Verify the timeout and the failure response. |
| FR-BR500-052 | SEQ-504 does not change FQI-521, except for decreases in WT-521. | Run SEQ-504 with a weight increase. Verify FQI-521 does not change. |

---

## 4.6 Interlocks and Permissives (cause-and-effect rows)

No cause-and-effect chart was supplied. These rows are the specification. Add them to the BR-500 C&E chart when it is issued (OI-02). None of these rows is an SIS function.

| Row | Cause | Effect | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-501 | FQI-521 at or above SPL-514 | Stop P-520. Base-side lockout. Alarm. | Latched for the batch | No reset in this batch. SEQ-501 at the next Media Fill clears it. No operator bypass. |
| I-502 | WT-521 unhealthy (bad status or outside SPL-518) | Stop P-520. Base-side lockout. Alarm. | Latched | Operator reset after WT-521 is healthy for SPL-538 and FQI-521 is below SPL-514. Reason required in Production. |
| I-503 | Both AT-501A and AT-501B unhealthy | AIC-501 to PV-FAIL HOLD. Stop P-520. FCV-510 holds its last SP. | Latched | Operator puts AIC-501 in MANUAL, then AUTO, after one probe is healthy. |
| I-504 | Both AT-502A and AT-502B unhealthy | AIC-502 to PV-FAIL HOLD. SIC-530, FCV-511, FCV-512 hold their last SPs. | Latched | Operator puts AIC-502 in MANUAL, then AUTO, after one probe is healthy. |
| I-505 | Phase not in Equilibrate, Inoculate, or Production | FCV-510/511/512 at zero. Stop P-520. Loops INACTIVE. | Auto-reset (permissive) | Clears by SEQ-502 at the start of Equilibrate. |
| I-506 | Vessel/bag overpressure (tag and logic in the BR-500 pressure section) | FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 to zero. Override of AIC-501/502 outputs. | Per the pressure section | Per the pressure section (OI-05). |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-060 | Each row I-501 to I-505 produces its effect when the cause occurs. | Force each cause. Verify each effect. |
| FR-BR500-061 | Each latched row stays active after the cause clears, until the reset method is used. | Clear each cause. Verify the effect stays. Do the reset. Verify the effect clears. |
| FR-BR500-062 | No user role can reset or bypass I-501 during the batch. | Try a reset and a bypass as Operator, Supervisor, and Engineer. Verify rejection. |

| ALM-514 | AT-502A or B | Probe unhealthy | Medium | Check the probe and cable. Tell Maintenance. |
| ALM-515 | AIC-502 | PV-FAIL HOLD (I-504) | Urgent | Control DO in MANUAL. Tell the supervisor. |
| ALM-516 | FCV-510/511/512 | Flow deviation above SPL-534 for SPL-535 | Medium | Check the gas supply and the MFC. |
| ALM-517 | SIC-530 | Speed deviation above SPL-536 for SPL-537 | High | Check the agitator drive. |
| ALM-518 | SEQ-504 | Bag change longer than SPL-519 | Medium | Complete the bag change. Confirm on the prompt. |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-070 | Each alarm ALM-501 to ALM-518 activates at its condition with its priority. It shows the response text. | Force each condition. Verify activation, priority, and text. |
| FR-BR500-071 | Process alarms ALM-501, 502, 510, 511, and 512 are suppressed while the loop is INACTIVE. | Put the loops in INACTIVE. Force each condition. Verify no annunciation. |

## 4.8 Abnormal Handling

### 4.8.1 Bad PV
- One probe bad: see FR-BR500-011.
- Both probes bad: see I-503 and I-504.
- WT-521 bad: see I-502.
- **Proposed hold behavior** (confirm with Process, OI-03):
  - AIC-501 holds CO2 at its last SP and stops base. Base without a valid pH can damage the culture.
  - AIC-502 holds all stages at their last SPs. A stop can make the culture go anoxic.

### 4.8.2 Communications loss
| Case | Response | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Operator station to controller | Control continues in the controller. SP changes are not possible. | FR-BR500-080 |
| Controller to a final element (FCV-510/511/512, P-520) | The element goes to its 4.8.4 fail position. Its loop stage goes to IMAN. Alarm. | FR-BR500-081 |
| Controller to an analyzer or WT-521 | The input is unhealthy. Apply 4.8.1. | FR-BR500-082 |
| Controller to SIC-530 drive | Drive holds its last speed (confirm with the drive configuration, OI-06). Alarm ALM-517. | FR-BR500-083 |

### 4.8.3 Power loss and restart
| Case | Response | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
